prompt: In a crisp anime style, the scene unfolds at a high-altitude mountain campsite where fourteen distinct elements coexist in harmony. On the left side of the frame, a girl with pink hair sits cross-legged on a blue sleeping bag, her posture relaxed as she holds a steaming mug. Next to her, a small orange cat curls into a tight ball, sleeping peacefully on the cold ground. A man in a red scarf stands nearby, pointing toward the distant peaks with his gloved hand, drawing the attention of a boy with glasses who looks up in awe. In the center, a large green tent dominates the space, its fabric taut against the wind. Beside the tent entrance, a brown dog sits alertly, watching a woman in a yellow jacket who is kneeling to tie her hiking boots. She is handing a water bottle to a teenager with spiky hair, who reaches out eagerly to accept it. To the right, an older man with a white beard leans against a sturdy oak tree, observing the group with a gentle smile. A black backpack rests on the ground next to him, slightly open to reveal rolled-up maps inside. Above them, a silver lantern hangs from a low branch, casting a soft glow despite the daylight. A wooden picnic table occupies the foreground, cluttered with various camping supplies. On the table, a metal pot sits next to a stack of firewood, ready for cooking. A young child with pigtails stands by the table, looking at a butterfly that flutters near their nose. The butterfly, vibrant and delicate, contrasts with the rugged surroundings. There is no snow on the ground, indicating a late summer setting. There is no visible moon in the sky, as the sun remains high and bright. The girl with pink hair is positioned on the left, the green tent is in the center, and the older man with the white beard is on the right. The man in the red scarf points at the mountains, creating a dynamic line of sight. The woman in the yellow jacket interacts with the teenager by handing over the bottle.
